0339bb49e072dcb45d144a7a34d4cc1e4c82cf9a.full_source:
help_aliases <- function(doc) {
  blocks <- Filter(function(x) identical(attr(x, "Rd_tag"), "\\alias"), doc)
  vapply(blocks, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ""), character(1))
}
old_help <- function(p) {
  text <- system2("git", c("show", paste0("a10a919:man/", p)), stdout = TRUE)
  connection <- textConnection(text)
  on.exit(close(connection))
  tools::parse_Rd(connection)
}
old_files <- system2("git", c("ls-tree", "--name-only", "a10a919:man"), stdout = TRUE)
old_files <- old_files[grepl("[.]Rd$", old_files)]
old_aliases <- unique(unlist(lapply(old_files, function(p) help_aliases(old_help(p)))))
current_files <- list.files("man", pattern = "[.]Rd$", full.names = TRUE)
current <- lapply(current_files, tools::parse_Rd)
new_aliases <- unique(unlist(lapply(current, help_aliases)))
lost <- setdiff(old_aliases, new_aliases)
cat("Previous help aliases:", length(old_aliases), "missing:", length(lost), "\n")

arguments <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(arguments) == 1L,
          arguments %in% c("unit", "equivalence", "references"))
kind <- arguments[[1L]]
destination <- "validation/release-0.96.1-2026-10-20"
source_files <- list.files("R", "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE)
before <- tools::md5sum(source_files)
started <- Sys.time()
commit <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE)
pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
cat("Commit:", commit, "\nPackage:", as.character(packageVersion("latents")), "\n")
folder <- switch(kind, unit = "tests/testthat", equivalence = "tests/equivalence",
                 references = "equivalence")
filter <- if (kind == "references") paste0("^(claims|latentgold|mclust(|-prior|-noise)|",
  "missing-patterns|mplus-(inference|robust|mixture-weights|lmr|missing-full)|",
  "numerical-equivalence)$") else NULL
results <- testthat::test_dir(folder, filter = filter, reporter = "summary",
  load_package = "none", stop_on_failure = FALSE)
saveRDS(results, file.path(destination, paste0(kind, "-final.rds")))
table <- as.data.frame(results)
write.csv(table[, setdiff(names(table), "result")],
  file.path(destination, paste0(kind, "-final.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
totals <- colSums(table[, c("nb", "failed", "error", "warning", "skipped", "passed")])
cat("\nTOTALS\n")
print(totals)
cat("Cases:", nrow(table), "\nElapsed:", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started,
  units = "secs")), "seconds\n")
unchanged <- identical(before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
cat("Production source unchanged:", unchanged, "\n")
write.csv(data.frame(file = names(before), md5 = unname(before)),
  file.path(destination, paste0(kind, "-final-source.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
print(sessionInfo())
if (!unchanged || any(totals[c("failed", "error", "warning", "skipped")] > 0)) {
  quit(status = 1L)
}

# Does a warm start from a less-constrained model's posteriors (JStats'
# strategy) reach the maxima the default search misses on the 9 VLMR cases?
# The package is unchanged: the warm start is passed through `start =`.
suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE))
here <- file.path("equivalence", "features", "vlmr")
cases <- readRDS(file.path(here, "kit", "cases.rds"))
comparisons <- utils::read.csv(file.path(here, "comparisons.csv"))
comparisons$k <- comparisons$null_k + 1L
missed <- data.frame(
  case = c("eei_k2_02", "eei_k3poor_02", "eei_k3poor_04", "eei_large_02", "eei_k1_01",
           "eei_k1_02", "eei_k1_05", "eee_k2_04", "eee_k2_04"),
  k = c(3L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 3L, 4L))
missed <- merge(missed, subset(comparisons, select = c(case, k, lg_ll1, mp_h1_ll)),
                by = c("case", "k"))
missed$reference <- pmax(missed$lg_ll1, missed$mp_h1_ll, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot("9 missed candidates with a finite reference" =
            nrow(missed) == 9L && all(is.finite(missed$reference)))

# One M-step of the target equal-covariance model from given posteriors.
start_from_posteriors <- function(x, posteriors, model) {
  weights <- colSums(posteriors)
  means <- crossprod(posteriors, x) / weights
  pooled <- Reduce(`+`, lapply(seq_len(ncol(posteriors)), \(j) {
    centred <- sweep(x, 2L, means[j, ], "-")
    crossprod(centred * posteriors[, j], centred)
  })) / nrow(x)
  k <- ncol(posteriors)
  start <- list(means = unname(means),
                variances = matrix(diag(pooled), k, ncol(x), byrow = TRUE),
                profile_probabilities = matrix(weights / sum(weights), 1L),
                group_probabilities = 1)
  if (identical(model, "EEE")) start$covariances <- array(pooled, c(ncol(x), ncol(x), k))
  start
}

quiet_lpa <- function(...) {
  warned <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(lpa(...), warning = \(w) {
    warned <<- c(warned, class(w)[[1L]])
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  })
  fit$warned <- unique(warned)
  fit
}

rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(missed)), \(i) {
  row <- missed[i, ]
  case <- cases[[row$case]]
  spec <- case$spec
  x <- as.matrix(case$data[spec$vars])
  n_starts <- if (spec$n >= 3000L) 30L else 60L
  controls <- list(n_starts = n_starts, seed = 1L, tol = 1e-12, max_iter = 5000)
  default <- do.call(quiet_lpa, c(list(case$data, spec$vars, row$k, model = spec$model), controls))
  warm_models <- if (identical(spec$model, "EEE")) "VVV" else c("VVV", "EEE")
  warm <- lapply(warm_models, \(warm_model) {
    base <- do.call(quiet_lpa, c(list(case$data, spec$vars, row$k, model = warm_model), controls))
    start <- start_from_posteriors(x, base$subject_posteriors, spec$model)
    refit <- quiet_lpa(case$data, spec$vars, row$k, model = spec$model, start = start,
                       n_starts = 1L, seed = 1L, tol = 1e-12, max_iter = 5000)
    data.frame(warm_model = warm_model, base_converged = base$converged,
               warm_ll = refit$log_likelihood, warm_converged = refit$converged)
  })
  warm <- do.call(rbind, warm)
  best_warm <- max(warm$warm_ll)
  data.frame(case = row$case, k = row$k, model = spec$model, n = spec$n,
             reference = row$reference, default_ll = default$log_likelihood,
             warm_from = paste(sprintf("%s:%.3f", warm$warm_model, warm$warm_ll), collapse = " "),
             best_ll = max(default$log_likelihood, best_warm),
             default_gap = default$log_likelihood - row$reference,
             with_warm_gap = max(default$log_likelihood, best_warm) - row$reference)
})
result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
result$default_reaches <- result$default_gap >= -1e-3
result$with_warm_reaches <- result$with_warm_gap >= -1e-3
options(width = 220)
print(result, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nReach the Mplus/Latent GOLD maximum: default %d of 9, default + warm starts %d of 9\n",
            sum(result$default_reaches), sum(result$with_warm_reaches)))
saveRDS(result, "/private/tmp/claude-503/-Users-mohammedsaqr-Documents-Github-latents/9bfae39a-cc34-4432-8b4f-db4045409538/scratchpad/warm-start-test.rds")

library(testthat)
library(latents)

log_sum <- function(x) max(x) + log(sum(exp(x - max(x))))

test_that("one-profile Gaussian fit and inference match independent MLE formulas", {
  set.seed(20261020)
  d <- data.frame(a = rnorm(150, 3, 1.5), b = rnorm(150, -2, 0.7))
  f <- lpa(d, c("a", "b"), n_profiles = 1, model = "VVV",
           n_starts = 1, seed = 7, tol = 1e-12)
  x <- as.matrix(d)
  mu <- colMeans(x)
  centered <- sweep(x, 2, mu)
  sigma <- crossprod(centered) / nrow(x)
  ll <- -nrow(x) / 2 * (2 * log(2 * pi) +
    as.numeric(determinant(sigma, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus) + 2)
  expect_equal(as.numeric(f$means), mu, ignore_attr = TRUE, tolerance = 1e-10)
  expect_equal(unname(f$covariances[, , 1]), unname(sigma), tolerance = 1e-10)
  expect_equal(f$log_likelihood, ll, tolerance = 1e-10)
  info <- parameter_inference(f)
  mean_rows <- info$parameter == "mean"
  expect_equal(info$standard_error[mean_rows], sqrt(diag(sigma) / nrow(x)),
               ignore_attr = TRUE, tolerance = 1e-6)
})

test_that("weighted Gaussian fit matches closed form weighted MLE", {
  set.seed(20261021)
  d <- data.frame(a = rnorm(180), b = rnorm(180), w = exp(rnorm(180)))
  f <- lpa(d, c("a", "b"), n_profiles = 1, model = "VVV", weights = "w",
           n_starts = 1, seed = 7, tol = 1e-12)
  x <- as.matrix(d[c("a", "b")])
  w <- d$w / sum(d$w) * nrow(x)
  mu <- colSums(x * w) / sum(w)
  r <- sweep(x, 2, mu)
  sigma <- crossprod(r, r * w) / sum(w)
  expect_equal(as.numeric(f$means), mu, ignore_attr = TRUE, tolerance = 1e-10)
  expect_equal(unname(f$covariances[, , 1]), unname(sigma), tolerance = 1e-10)
  info <- parameter_inference(f)
  expect_true(all(is.finite(info$standard_error)))
  expect_identical(attr(info, "vcov_type"), "robust")
})

test_that("nested mixture evaluate-only likelihood matches exact marginalization", {
  d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:4, c(2, 3, 2, 3)),
                  y = c(-2, 1, 0, 1, 2, -1, -2, 2, 1, -1))
  start <- list(means = matrix(c(-1, 2), 2, 1),
                variances = matrix(c(0.8, 1.2), 2, 1),
                profile_probabilities = rbind(c(0.8, 0.2), c(0.3, 0.7)),
                group_probabilities = c(0.4, 0.6))
  f <- multilpa(d, "y", "id", n_profiles = 2, n_group_classes = 2,
                start = start, max_iter = 0, n_starts = 1)
  group_ll <- vapply(split(d$y, d$id), function(y) {
    group_terms <- vapply(1:2, function(g) {
      log(start$group_probabilities[g]) + sum(vapply(y, function(value) {
        log_sum(log(start$profile_probabilities[g, ]) +
          dnorm(value, start$means[, 1], sqrt(start$variances[, 1]), log = TRUE))
      }, numeric(1)))
    }, numeric(1))
    log_sum(group_terms)
  }, numeric(1))
  expect_equal(f$log_likelihood, sum(group_ll), tolerance = 1e-12)
  expect_equal(rowSums(f$subject_posteriors), rep(1, nrow(d)),
               ignore_attr = TRUE, tolerance = 1e-12)
  expect_equal(rowSums(f$group_posteriors), rep(1, 4),
               ignore_attr = TRUE, tolerance = 1e-12)
})

test_that("FIML likelihood equals independent observed-margin Gaussian densities", {
  set.seed(20261022)
  d <- data.frame(a = rnorm(160), b = rnorm(160))
  d$a[seq(2, 160, 4)] <- NA_real_
  d$b[seq(3, 160, 4)] <- NA_real_
  f <- lpa(d, c("a", "b"), n_profiles = 1, model = "VVV", missing = "fiml",
           n_starts = 1, seed = 7, tol = 1e-12)
  sigma <- f$covariances[, , 1]
  densities <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) {
    observed <- which(!is.na(d[i, ]))
    r <- as.numeric(d[i, observed]) - f$means[1, observed]
    s <- sigma[observed, observed, drop = FALSE]
    -0.5 * (length(observed) * log(2 * pi) +
      as.numeric(determinant(s, logarithm = TRUE)$modulus) +
      as.numeric(crossprod(r, solve(s, r))))
  }, numeric(1))
  expect_equal(f$log_likelihood, sum(densities), tolerance = 1e-11)
  expect_true(f$converged)
})

calls_in <- function(e) {
  if (!is.call(e) && !is.pairlist(e) && !is.expression(e)) return(character())
  current <- if (is.call(e)) {
    if (is.symbol(e[[1L]])) as.character(e[[1L]]) else
      if (is.call(e[[1L]]) && identical(e[[1L]][[1L]], as.name("::"))) paste0(as.character(e[[1L]][[2L]]), "::", as.character(e[[1L]][[3L]])) else "<computed call>"
  } else character()
  nested <- lapply(as.list(e), function(part) {
    if (is.symbol(part) && identical(part, quote(expr = ))) character() else calls_in(part)
  })
  unique(c(current, unlist(nested, use.names = FALSE)))
}

  old <- if (is.null(attr(baseline, "status"))) parse(text = baseline) else expression()
  old_definitions <- Filter(function(e) is.call(e) && is.symbol(e[[1L]]) && identical(e[[1L]], as.name("<-")) && is.symbol(e[[2L]]), as.list(old))
  old_by_name <- stats::setNames(lapply(old_definitions, function(e) e[[3L]]), vapply(old_definitions, function(e) as.character(e[[2L]]), character(1)))
  refs <- attr(parsed, "srcref")
  assignments <- which(vapply(parsed, function(e) is.call(e) && is.symbol(e[[1L]]) && as.character(e[[1L]]) %in% c("<-", "=") && is.symbol(e[[2L]]), logical(1)))
  lapply(assignments, function(i) {
    expr <- parsed[[i]]
    name <- as.character(expr[[2L]])
    rhs <- expr[[3L]]
    is_function <- is.call(rhs) && identical(rhs[[1L]], as.name("function"))
    is_alias <- is.symbol(rhs)
    if (!is_function && !is_alias) return(NULL)
    start <- as.integer(refs[[i]])[1L]
    end <- as.integer(refs[[i]])[3L]
    literal <- paste0("\\alias{", name, "}")
    docs <- names(rd_text)[vapply(rd_text, grepl, logical(1), pattern = literal, fixed = TRUE)]
    needle <- paste0(name, "(")
    test_hits <- names(test_text)[vapply(test_text, grepl, logical(1), pattern = needle, fixed = TRUE)]
    symbols <- names(test_symbols)[vapply(test_symbols, function(s) name %in% s, logical(1))]
    calls <- sort(calls_in(rhs))
    roxy_start <- start - 1L
    preceding <- if (roxy_start > 0L) text[seq_len(roxy_start)] else character()
    last_blank <- max(c(0L, which(!grepl("^#", preceding))))
    roxy <- preceding[seq.int(last_blank + 1L, length(preceding))]
    purpose <- roxy[grepl("^#' [^@]", roxy)]
    purpose <- if (length(purpose)) sub("^#' *", "", purpose[1L]) else ""
    validation <- intersect(calls, c("stopifnot", "match.arg", ".multilpa_check_seed", ".multilpa_check_alignment", ".multilpa_check_row_count", ".multilpa_check_regularity"))
    conditions <- intersect(calls, c("stop", "warning", "message", "tryCatch", "withCallingHandlers", "errorCondition", "warningCondition"))
    random <- calls[grepl("(^|::)(rnorm|runif|rbinom|rpois|rnbinom|sample|sample.int|set.seed)$", calls)]
    io <- calls[grepl("(^|::)(writeLines|write.csv|saveRDS|readRDS|read.csv|system|system2|unlink|file.copy|setwd|options|par|assign)$", calls)]
    body_changed <- !name %in% names(old_by_name) || !identical(deparse(rhs), deparse(old_by_name[[name]]))
    data.frame(file = file, name = name, line = start, end_line = end,
               definition = if (is_function) "function" else "alias_or_constant",
               public = name %in% c(exports, methods),
               documented_in = paste(docs, collapse = ";"),
               direct_test_text_files = paste(test_hits, collapse = ";"),
               direct_test_text_count = length(test_hits),
               purpose = purpose,
               arguments = if (is_function) paste(names(rhs[[2L]]), collapse = ";") else "",
               called_functions = paste(calls, collapse = ";"),
               validation_calls = paste(validation, collapse = ";"),
               condition_calls = paste(conditions, collapse = ";"),
               random_calls = paste(random, collapse = ";"),
               state_or_io_calls = paste(io, collapse = ";"),
               direct_test_symbol_files = paste(symbols, collapse = ";"),
               direct_test_symbol_count = length(symbols),
               body_changed_since_head = body_changed,
               review_status = "parsed and indexed; specialist review in separate reports",
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
})

  variances <- solve_variance(diagonals,weights,code,.1)
  list(code=code,variances=variances,determinants=apply(variances,1,prod), ratios=variances[1,]/variances[2,])

                y=c(rnorm(100,0,1),rnorm(100,0,.3)))

  warnings <- character()
  tryCatch({
    fit <- withCallingHandlers(lpa(d,c('x','y'),2,model=code,min_variance=.05,n_starts=1,seed=1,tol=1e-10),
                               warning=function(w) { warnings <<- c(warnings,conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart('muffleWarning')})
    matrices <- if (!is.null(fit$covariances)) lapply(1:2,function(k) matrix(fit$covariances[,,k],2,2)) else
      lapply(1:2,function(k) diag(fit$variances[k,]))
    list(code=code,converged=fit$converged,variance=fit$variances, determinants=vapply(matrices,det,numeric(1)),
         eigenvalues=lapply(matrices,eigen,symmetric=TRUE,only.values=TRUE),warnings=warnings)
  },error=function(e) list(code=code,error=conditionMessage(e),class=class(e),warnings=warnings))
})
print(fits)

capture_fit <- function(...) {

  list(fit=fit,warnings=warnings)
}

# Read-only public API probes of HEAD 12e0145; run from the repository root.
# Third probe reproduces the bootstrap's EXACT ARGUMENT RECONSTRUCTION;
# it refits the original data, rather than performing a stochastic bootstrap.
Sys.setenv(VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS='1', OMP_NUM_THREADS='1', OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1')
pkgload::load_all('.', quiet=TRUE)
with_notices <- function(expr) {
  notices <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(expr, warning=function(w) {
    notices <<- c(notices, paste(class(w)[1], conditionMessage(w), sep=': '))
    invokeRestart('muffleWarning')
  })
  list(fit=fit, notices=notices)
}
cat('Probe 1: all-missing subjects should not change thin-profile warning\n')
set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(g=rep(1:30,each=3),t=rep(1:3,30),
                a=c(rnorm(87),rnorm(3,20)),b=c(rnorm(87),rnorm(3,20)))
args <- list(vars=c('a','b'),id='g',n_profiles=2,time='t',missing='fiml',
             n_starts=1,seed=1,max_iter=500)
x <- with_notices(do.call(lta,c(list(data=d),args)))
e <- data.frame(g=rep(31:130,each=3),t=rep(1:3,100),a=NA_real_,b=NA_real_)
y <- with_notices(do.call(lta,c(list(data=rbind(d,e)),args)))
invisible(lapply(list(original=x, with_empty=y), function(pair) {
  cat('LL: ',format(pair$fit$log_likelihood,digits=16),'\n',sep='')
  cat('Effective counts: ',paste(pair$fit$effective_profile_counts,collapse=', '),'\n',sep='')
  cat('Raw sums: ',paste(colSums(pair$fit$subject_posteriors),collapse=', '),'\n',sep='')
  cat('Warnings: ',paste(pair$notices,collapse=' | '),'\n',sep='')
}))
cat('Expected: both should warn for the same 3-member profile (4 own parameters).\n')
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(x$fit$log_likelihood,y$fit$log_likelihood,tolerance=1e-8)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(x$fit$effective_profile_counts,y$fit$effective_profile_counts,tolerance=1e-8)))

cat('\nProbe 2: occasion-specific measurement should assess each separate block\n')
set.seed(1)
d2 <- data.frame(g=rep(1:30,each=3),t=rep(1:3,30),
                 a=c(rnorm(84),rnorm(6,20)),b=c(rnorm(84),rnorm(6,20)))
z <- with_notices(lta(d2,c('a','b'),'g',2,time='t',measurement='occasion',
                       n_starts=1,seed=1,max_iter=200))
cat('Pooled counts: ',paste(colSums(z$fit$subject_posteriors),collapse=', '),'\n',sep='')
cat('Memberships by occasion:\n')
print(rowsum(z$fit$subject_posteriors,d2$t))
cat('Measurement blocks: ',length(z$fit$measurement),'\n',sep='')
cat('Warnings: ',paste(z$notices,collapse=' | '),'\n',sep='')
cat('Expected: rare profile warns; each block has 2 effective members for 4 own parameters.\n')

cat('\nProbe 3: exact staged-bootstrap argument reconstruction, without resampling\n')
set.seed(6)
d3 <- data.frame(g=rep(1:12,each=4),a=rnorm(48),b=rnorm(48))
staged <- with_notices(fit_staged(d3,c('a','b'),'g',2,2,n_starts=1,n_screen=8,
                                 search='emEM',seed=1,max_iter=20))$fit
args <- latents:::.multilpa_staged_refit_arguments(staged)
control <- latents:::.latents_refit_controls(staged,n_starts=1)
# Mirrors R/bootstrap-inference.R:134-137, with resampled := original d3.
refit <- with_notices(do.call(fit_staged,c(list(data=d3),args,
  list(n_starts=1,max_iter=20,tol=1e-8,n_screen=control$n_screen))))$fit
cat('Original first-stage pool: ',staged$stage_one$n_screen,
    '; screened rows: ',nrow(staged$stage_one$starts),'\n',sep='')
cat('Returned second-stage pool: ',if(is.null(staged$n_screen)) 'NULL' else staged$n_screen,'\n',sep='')
cat('Inherited bootstrap pool: ',if(is.null(control$n_screen)) 'NULL' else control$n_screen,'\n',sep='')
cat('Reconstructed first-stage pool: ',refit$stage_one$n_screen,
    '; screened rows: ',nrow(refit$stage_one$starts),'\n',sep='')
cat('Expected: reconstructed first-stage pool remains 8.\n')

pkgload::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(551)
n <- 400
d <- data.frame(z = rnorm(n), w = rnorm(n))
d$y1 <- 1 + .4 * d$z + .7 * d$w + rnorm(n)
d$y2 <- rnorm(n)
attempt <- function(code) tryCatch(force(code), error = function(e) e)
fit <- function(data) suppressWarnings(lpa(data, c("y1", "y2"), 1,
  direct_effects = "y1 ~ z + w", n_starts = 1, seed = 1, tol = 1e-12))
base <- fit(d)
base_inf <- parameter_inference(base)
cat("Covariate shifts, unchanged maximum likelihood, and inference result:\n")
shifts <- c(0, 10, 100, 300, 1000, 2026)
shift_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(shifts, function(shift) {
  changed <- transform(d, z = z + shift)
  fitted <- fit(changed)
  inference <- attempt(parameter_inference(fitted))
  reference <- lm(y1 ~ z + w, data = changed)
  reference_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(reference)) * reference$df.residual / n)
  data.frame(shift = shift, likelihood_delta = fitted$log_likelihood - base$log_likelihood,
    effect_delta = max(abs(fitted$direct_effects - base$direct_effects)),
    slope_reference_se = reference_se[["z"]],
    reference_intercept_se = reference_se[["(Intercept)"]],
    inference = if (inherits(inference, "error")) class(inference)[1L] else "success")
}))
print(shift_results, digits = 12)
stopifnot(all(abs(shift_results$likelihood_delta) < 1e-8),
          shift_results$inference[1L] == "success",
          shift_results$inference[length(shifts)] == "latents_singular_information")
cat("Base direct-effect SEs versus independent lm MLE reference:\n")
print(subset(base_inf, parameter == "direct_effect", select = c(term, standard_error)))
ref <- lm(y1 ~ z + w, data = d)
print(sqrt(diag(vcov(ref)) * ref$df.residual / n))

cat("\nMultiple-covariate units: fit status, likelihood and coefficients:\n")
scales <- c(1, 1e4, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8)
unit_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(scales, function(scale) {
  fitted <- attempt(fit(transform(d, w = w * scale)))
  data.frame(scale = scale,
    likelihood = if (inherits(fitted, "error")) NA_real_ else fitted$log_likelihood,
    result = if (inherits(fitted, "error")) conditionMessage(fitted) else "success")
}))
print(unit_results, digits = 12)

set.seed(22)
items <- as.data.frame(matrix(rbinom(400 * 4, 1, .5), 400, 4))
names(items) <- c("a", "b", "a:b", "c")
colliding <- lca(items, names(items), 1, local_dependence = "a:b", n_starts = 1)
manual <- items
manual$joint <- interaction(manual$a, manual$b, sep = ":", lex.order = TRUE)
correct <- lca(manual, c("joint", "a:b", "c"), 1, n_starts = 1)
cat("\nExisting indicator a:b overwritten by generated a:b:\n")
print(data.frame(implementation = c("current local_dependence", "collision-free joint reference"),
  n_parameters = c(colliding$n_parameters, correct$n_parameters),
  log_likelihood = c(colliding$log_likelihood, correct$log_likelihood)))
stopifnot(colliding$n_parameters == 4, correct$n_parameters == 5,
          !identical(as.character(items[["a:b"]]),
                     as.character(get_results(colliding, "data")[["a:b"]])))

cat("\nAdditional combination smoke checks:\n")
set.seed(111)
mixed <- transform(d, a = factor(rbinom(n, 1, .5)), b = factor(rbinom(n, 1, .5)),
                   count = rpois(n, 2), ordinal = ordered(sample(1:3, n, TRUE)))
extended <- lpa(mixed, c("y1", "y2", "a", "b", "count", "ordinal"), 1,
  categorical = c("a", "b"), count = "count", ordinal = "ordinal",
  local_dependence = "a:b", direct_effects = "y1 ~ z + w", n_starts = 1, seed = 1,
  tol = 1e-12)
stopifnot(isTRUE(extended$converged))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(predict(extended, type = "posterior"),
                         predict(extended, mixed, type = "posterior"))))
extended_inf <- parameter_inference(extended)

.latents_vuong_weights.source:
.latents_vuong_weights <- function(alternative, null) {
  stopifnot("the two models must be scored on the same units" =
              nrow(alternative$scores) == nrow(null$scores))
  # Congruent scaling of information and score columns changes only the
  # chart, so Vuong's eigenvalues are unchanged. Raw inverses can otherwise
  # reject a regular model merely because an indicator's units changed.
  condition <- function(parts) {
    diagonal <- diag(parts$information)
    if (any(!is.finite(diagonal) | diagonal <= 0)) {
      stop(errorCondition("The Vuong comparison information is not positive definite.",
                          class = "latents_singular_information", call = NULL))
    }
    scale <- 1 / sqrt(diagonal)
    parts$scores <- sweep(parts$scores, 2L, scale, "*")
    parts$information <- parts$information * tcrossprod(scale)
    parts
  }
  alternative <- condition(alternative)
  null <- condition(null)
  whiten <- function(parts) {
    tryCatch({
      root <- chol(parts$information)
      inverse <- backsolve(root, diag(ncol(root)))
      scores <- t(backsolve(root, t(parts$scores), transpose = TRUE))
      columns <- ncol(root)
      epsilon <- .Machine$double.eps
      gamma <- columns * epsilon / (1 - columns * epsilon)
      chol_gamma <- (columns + 1) * epsilon / (1 - (columns + 1) * epsilon)
      # Cholesky has componentwise backward error gamma[p+1] |R'| |R|.
      # Include the preceding diagonal congruence's two rounded products,
      # then propagate that information error through R^-1. Near-collinear
      # charts amplify it even though the final score matrix has unit scale.
      information_error <- chol_gamma * crossprod(abs(root)) +
        (2 * epsilon / (1 - 2 * epsilon)) * abs(parts$information)
      relative_error <- norm(crossprod(abs(inverse),
        information_error %*% abs(inverse)), "2")
      if (!is.finite(relative_error) || relative_error >= 1) {
        stop("Information whitening cannot resolve the fitted coordinates.")
      }
      score_norm <- norm(scores, "2")
      # Triangular solves and the initial score scaling have componentwise
      # error bounds too. Bound the resulting perturbation of S S' by
      # 2 ||S|| ||dS|| + ||dS||^2; Weyl then bounds every reference weight.
      score_error <- gamma * norm(abs(scores) %*% abs(root) %*% abs(inverse), "2") +
        epsilon * norm(abs(parts$scores) %*% abs(inverse), "2")
      weight_error <- score_norm^2 * relative_error / (1 - relative_error) +
        2 * score_norm * score_error + score_error^2
      list(scores = scores, weight_error = weight_error)
    }, error = function(condition) {
      stop(errorCondition("The Vuong comparison information is singular or nonpositive.",
                          class = "latents_singular_information", call = NULL))
    })
  }
  alternative_whitened <- whiten(alternative)
  null_whitened <- whiten(null)
  combined <- cbind(alternative_whitened$scores, null_whitened$scores)
  signs <- c(rep(1, ncol(alternative$scores)), rep(-1, ncol(null$scores)))
  # W is similar to J S'S for the information-whitened combined scores S.
  # Its nonzero eigenvalues equal those of S J S'. With S = U D V', use
  # the smaller symmetric D V' J V D: the unsymmetric W has defective zero
  # eigenvalues in regular nested models, and a generic eigen() can turn
  # their rounding error into spurious positive/negative weights of 1e-7.
  decomposition <- svd(combined, nu = 0L)
  signed <- crossprod(decomposition$v, signs * decomposition$v) *
    tcrossprod(decomposition$d)
  weights <- eigen(signed, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  # This is the backward-error scale of the symmetric matrix construction,
  # not a probability-independent relative cutoff in the Imhof helper.
  rounding <- 64 * .Machine$double.eps * ncol(combined) * max(decomposition$d)^2 +
    alternative_whitened$weight_error + null_whitened$weight_error
  weights[abs(weights) <= rounding] <- 0
  c(weights, rep(0, ncol(combined) - length(weights)))
}

# The Vuong-Lo-Mendell-Rubin test of K against K + 1 classes (Vuong 1989;
# Lo, Mendell and Rubin 2001), in the form Latent GOLD implements (Vermunt
# 2024). The likelihood-ratio statistic LR = 2 (l1 - l0) is referred to a
# weighted sum of independent chi-square(1) variables whose weights are the
# eigenvalues of
#
#   W = [ -B1 A1^-1   -B10 A0^-1 ]
#       [ B10' A1^-1   B0 A0^-1  ],
#
# with A the Hessian of each model's log likelihood, B the cross-product of
# its per-unit scores and B10 the cross-product of the larger model's scores
# with the smaller one's. The p-value is computed by Imhof's (1961) method.

#' The scores and Hessian of one fitted model, for Vuong's test
#'
#' Read from [parameter_inference()] with `vcov_type = "robust"`, which keeps
#' the per-unit (per-group) scores; its observed information is computed once
#' per session for a fit and reused.
#' @param fit A fitted profile or class model.
#' @return A list of `scores` (units by free coordinates), `information`
#'   (minus the Hessian, in the same coordinates), `log_likelihood` and
#'   `n_parameters` and the counted independent `n_units`.
#' @noRd
.latents_vuong_parts <- function(fit) {
  inference <- parameter_inference(fit, vcov_type = "robust")
  list(scores = attr(inference, "group_scores_conditioned") %||%
         attr(inference, "group_scores"),
       information = attr(inference, "hessian_conditioned") %||%
         attr(inference, "hessian"),
       log_likelihood = fit$log_likelihood, n_parameters = fit$n_parameters,
       n_units = sum(.multilpa_inference_groups(fit)))
}

#' The weights of the reference distribution of Vuong's statistic
#'
#' With `A = -information`, `-B A^-1 = B information^-1`, so in terms of the
#' information matrices
#' `W = [ B1 I1^-1, B10 I0^-1 ; -B10' I1^-1, -B0 I0^-1 ]`.
#' For two regular nested models whose information equals the variance of
#' the score, the nonzero eigenvalues are `p1 - p0` ones, and the reference
#' distribution is the familiar chi-square on `p1 - p0` degrees of freedom.
#' @param alternative,null From `.latents_vuong_parts()`, on the same units.
#' @return The eigenvalues of `W`, computed from an equivalent symmetric matrix.
#' @noRd
.latents_vuong_weights <- function(alternative, null) {
  stopifnot("the two models must be scored on the same units" =
              nrow(alternative$scores) == nrow(null$scores))
  # Congruent scaling of information and score columns changes only the
  # chart, so Vuong's eigenvalues are unchanged. Raw inverses can otherwise
  # reject a regular model merely because an indicator's units changed.
  condition <- function(parts) {
    diagonal <- diag(parts$information)
    if (any(!is.finite(diagonal) | diagonal <= 0)) {
      stop(errorCondition("The Vuong comparison information is not positive definite.",
                          class = "latents_singular_information", call = NULL))
    }
    scale <- 1 / sqrt(diagonal)
    parts$scores <- sweep(parts$scores, 2L, scale, "*")
    parts$information <- parts$information * tcrossprod(scale)
    parts
  }
  alternative <- condition(alternative)
  null <- condition(null)
  whiten <- function(parts) {
    tryCatch({
      root <- chol(parts$information)
      inverse <- backsolve(root, diag(ncol(root)))
      scores <- t(backsolve(root, t(parts$scores), transpose = TRUE))
      columns <- ncol(root)
      epsilon <- .Machine$double.eps
      gamma <- columns * epsilon / (1 - columns * epsilon)
      chol_gamma <- (columns + 1) * epsilon / (1 - (columns + 1) * epsilon)
      # Cholesky has componentwise backward error gamma[p+1] |R'| |R|.
      # Include the preceding diagonal congruence's two rounded products,
      # then propagate that information error through R^-1. Near-collinear
      # charts amplify it even though the final score matrix has unit scale.
      information_error <- chol_gamma * crossprod(abs(root)) +
        (2 * epsilon / (1 - 2 * epsilon)) * abs(parts$information)
      relative_error <- norm(crossprod(abs(inverse),
        information_error %*% abs(inverse)), "2")
      if (!is.finite(relative_error) || relative_error >= 1) {
        stop("Information whitening cannot resolve the fitted coordinates.")
      }
      score_norm <- norm(scores, "2")
      # Triangular solves and the initial score scaling have componentwise
      # error bounds too. Bound the resulting perturbation of S S' by
      # 2 ||S|| ||dS|| + ||dS||^2; Weyl then bounds every reference weight.
      score_error <- gamma * norm(abs(scores) %*% abs(root) %*% abs(inverse), "2") +
        epsilon * norm(abs(parts$scores) %*% abs(inverse), "2")
      weight_error <- score_norm^2 * relative_error / (1 - relative_error) +
        2 * score_norm * score_error + score_error^2
      list(scores = scores, weight_error = weight_error)
    }, error = function(condition) {
      stop(errorCondition("The Vuong comparison information is singular or nonpositive.",
                          class = "latents_singular_information", call = NULL))
    })
  }
  alternative_whitened <- whiten(alternative)
  null_whitened <- whiten(null)
  combined <- cbind(alternative_whitened$scores, null_whitened$scores)
  signs <- c(rep(1, ncol(alternative$scores)), rep(-1, ncol(null$scores)))
  # W is similar to J S'S for the information-whitened combined scores S.
  # Its nonzero eigenvalues equal those of S J S'. With S = U D V', use
  # the smaller symmetric D V' J V D: the unsymmetric W has defective zero
  # eigenvalues in regular nested models, and a generic eigen() can turn
  # their rounding error into spurious positive/negative weights of 1e-7.
  decomposition <- svd(combined, nu = 0L)
  signed <- crossprod(decomposition$v, signs * decomposition$v) *
    tcrossprod(decomposition$d)
  weights <- eigen(signed, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
  # This is the backward-error scale of the symmetric matrix construction,
  # not a probability-independent relative cutoff in the Imhof helper.
  rounding <- 64 * .Machine$double.eps * ncol(combined) * max(decomposition$d)^2 +
    alternative_whitened$weight_error + null_whitened$weight_error
  weights[abs(weights) <= rounding] <- 0
  c(weights, rep(0, ncol(combined) - length(weights)))
}

#' Upper tail of a weighted sum of chi-square(1) variables (Imhof 1961)
#'
#' `P(sum_j lambda_j X_j > q)` for independent `X_j ~ chi-square(1)`:
#' `1/2 + (1/pi) int_0^Inf sin(theta(u)) / (u rho(u)) du`, with
#' `theta(u) = sum_j atan(lambda_j u) / 2 - q u / 2` and
#' `rho(u) = prod_j (1 + lambda_j^2 u^2)^(1/4)`. Weights that are
#' exactly zero contribute nothing and are dropped. Small nonzero weights
#' are retained: their relative size does not bound the probability error
#' near a statistic of zero. Negative statistics are handled by the symmetry
#' `P(Q > q) = 1 - P(-Q > -q)` for the continuous nonzero-weight distribution.
#'
#' The integral has two regimes, and each is integrated where it is smooth.
#' Up to `u = 2 pi / q` the phase is dominated by the arctangents, which bend
#' at `u = 1 / |lambda_j|`; that lead is integrated by adaptive quadrature
#' between breakpoints at those scales and at every decade, so no segment
#' spans more than an order of magnitude. When `q = 0` there is no
#' oscillation at all and the lead is the whole integral, ended where
#' Imhof's truncation bound falls below `1e-12`: with weights of both
#' signs the integrand then decays monotonically, and extrapolating its
#' partial sums (the method this replaces) settled on wrong limits, 32% off
#' for weights `(1, -1e4, -1e4, -1e4)`. Beyond the lead, `sin(q u / 2)`
#' dominates, so the tail is integrated in half-periods aligned to it, whose
#' partial sums alternate, and accelerated by Wynn's epsilon algorithm, as
#' QUADPACK's QAWF does for Fourier integrals. The value is accepted when two
#' successive estimates agree to `1e-10`; otherwise, or when a segment cannot
#' be integrated, `latents_inaccurate_probability` is raised. The integral
#' is taken on weights normalised to unit size, which leaves the probability
#' unchanged. Against 312 exact F and chi-square probabilities and two-weight
#' convolutions, with weights from 1e-6 to 1e6, the absolute error is at most
#' 3.2e-13 when `q = 0` and 1e-15 otherwise.
#' @param q The statistic.
#' @param lambda The weights.
#' @return A probability.
#' @noRd
.latents_imhof_upper <- function(q, lambda) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(q), length(q) == 1L, is.finite(q),
            is.numeric(lambda), all(is.finite(lambda)))
  lambda <- lambda[lambda != 0]
  if (length(lambda) == 0L) return(as.numeric(q < 0))
  if (q < 0) return(1 - .latents_imhof_upper(-q, -lambda))
  if (q == 0 && all(lambda > 0)) return(1)
  if (all(lambda < 0)) return(0)
  # P(sum lambda_j X_j > q) = P(sum (lambda_j / c) X_j > q / c): the integral
  # is taken on weights of unit size, so its breakpoints and tolerances do
  # not depend on the weights' units (weights of size 1e-6 failed to
  # integrate before).
  size <- max(abs(lambda))
  lambda <- lambda / size
  q <- q / size
  integrand <- function(u) {
    theta <- 0.5 * vapply(u, function(value) sum(atan(lambda * value)), numeric(1)) -
      0.5 * q * u
    log_rho <- vapply(u, function(value) {
      # log(1 + exp(2 z)) without squaring huge integration coordinates or
      # multiplying many small factors; both overflow at extreme weight ratios.
      logs <- log(abs(lambda)) + log(value)
      sum(0.5 * pmax(logs, 0) + 0.25 * log1p(exp(-2 * abs(logs))))
    }, numeric(1))
    ifelse(u == 0, 0.5 * (sum(lambda) - q),
           sin(theta) * exp(-log(u) - log_rho))
  }
  inaccurate <- function(reason) {
    stop(errorCondition(sprintf(paste(
      "The tail probability of the weighted chi-square distribution %s",
      "(statistic %g, %d weights); the p-value cannot be reported."),
      reason, q, length(lambda)), class = "latents_inaccurate_probability", call = NULL))
  }
  segment <- function(lower, upper) {
    tryCatch(stats::integrate(integrand, lower, upper, rel.tol = 1e-11,
                              abs.tol = 1e-14, subdivisions = 2000L)$value,
             error = function(condition) {
               inaccurate(sprintf("could not be integrated over [%g, %g]: %s", lower,
                                  upper, conditionMessage(condition)))
             })
  }
  clamp <- function(integral) min(1, max(0, 0.5 + integral / pi))
  if (any(lambda == 0)) inaccurate("has weights beyond representable relative precision")
  scales <- 1 / abs(lambda)
  # With q = 0 the lead is the whole integral. Past u its integrand is at
  # most u^(-1 - n/2) / prod |lambda_j|^(1/2), so the rest is at most
  # (2 / n) u^(-n/2) / prod |lambda_j|^(1/2) (Imhof 1961); the lead ends
  # where that bound is 1e-12, and nothing is left to an infinite range.
  n_weights <- length(lambda)
  truncation <- exp(2 / n_weights *
    (log(2 / n_weights) - log(1e-12) - 0.5 * sum(log(abs(lambda)))))
  lead_end <- if (q > 0) 2 * pi / q else max(truncation, 1e3 * max(scales))
  if (!is.finite(lead_end) || any(!is.finite(scales))) {
    inaccurate("has weights or a statistic beyond the integration range")
  }
  top <- lead_end
  decades <- 10^seq(floor(log10(min(scales))), ceiling(log10(top)))
  breaks <- sort(unique(c(0, scales, decades)))
  breaks <- c(breaks[breaks < lead_end], lead_end)
  lead <- sum(vapply(seq_len(length(breaks) - 1L), function(index) {
    segment(breaks[index], breaks[index + 1L])
  }, numeric(1)))
  if (q <= 0) return(clamp(lead))
  half_period <- 2 * pi / q
  piece <- function(k) segment(lead_end + k * half_period, lead_end + (k + 1) * half_period)
  pieces <- vapply(seq_len(20L) - 1L, piece, numeric(1))
  previous <- .latents_wynn(lead + cumsum(pieces))
  # Each round adds 20 half-periods until two successive estimates agree;
  # the number of rounds is bounded, and reaching the bound is reported.
  round <- 0L
  while (round < 25L) {
    round <- round + 1L
    pieces <- c(pieces, vapply(length(pieces) + seq_len(20L) - 1L, piece, numeric(1)))
    current <- .latents_wynn(lead + cumsum(pieces))
    if (abs(current - previous) < 1e-10) return(clamp(current))
    previous <- current
  }
  inaccurate("did not settle")
}

#' The limit of a sequence by Wynn's epsilon algorithm
#'
#' Builds the epsilon table column by column from the partial sums `s`
#' (`e[-1] = 0`, `e[0] = s`, `e[j + 1][k] = e[j - 1][k + 1] + 1 /
#' (e[j][k + 1] - e[j][k])`) and returns the last entry of the last even
#' column, the accelerated limit. Two equal neighbours mean the sequence has
#' already settled there.
#' @param s Partial sums.
#' @return The estimated limit.
#' @noRd
.latents_wynn <- function(s) {
  table <- list(rep(0, length(s) + 1L), s)
  limit <- s[length(s)]
  # The table is built column by column, each from the two before it.
  while (length(table[[length(table)]]) > 2L) {
    current <- table[[length(table)]]
    before <- table[[length(table) - 1L]]
    gaps <- diff(current)
    if (any(gaps == 0)) break
    following <- before[-c(1L, length(before))][seq_along(gaps)] + 1 / gaps
    table <- c(table, list(following))
    if ((length(table) - 2L) %% 2L == 0L) limit <- following[length(following)]
  }
  limit
}

#' One VLMR and adjusted LMR comparison of two fitted candidates
#'
#' The adjusted statistic divides LR by `1 + 1 / (d log n)`, with `d` the
#' difference in the number of parameters and `n` the number of independent
#' units (Lo, Mendell and Rubin 2001, eq. 15, with their three parameters per
#' added univariate normal component replaced by the models' own difference),
#' and is referred to the same distribution.
#' @param alternative,null From `.latents_vuong_parts()`.
#' @return A one-row data frame: `n_units`, `parameters_added`, `lr`,
#'   `vlmr_p`, `adjusted_lr`, `almr_p`, `reference_mean`, `reference_sd`.
#' @noRd
.latents_vuong_row <- function(alternative, null) {
  lr <- 2 * (alternative$log_likelihood - null$log_likelihood)
  if (lr < -1e-8 * (1 + abs(null$log_likelihood))) {
    stop(errorCondition(paste("The alternative has a lower likelihood than the null;",
                              "the nested comparison needs a better-fitting alternative."),
                        class = "latents_invalid_lmr", call = NULL))
  }
  lr <- max(0, lr)
  lambda <- .latents_vuong_weights(alternative, null)
  added <- alternative$n_parameters - null$n_parameters
  n_units <- alternative$n_units %||% nrow(alternative$scores)
  stopifnot("the two models must count the same independent units" =
              n_units == (null$n_units %||% nrow(null$scores)))
  adjusted <- lr / (1 + 1 / (added * log(n_units)))
  data.frame(n_units = n_units, parameters_added = added, lr = lr,
             vlmr_p = .latents_imhof_upper(lr, lambda), adjusted_lr = adjusted,
             almr_p = .latents_imhof_upper(adjusted, lambda),
             reference_mean = sum(lambda), reference_sd = sqrt(2 * sum(lambda^2)))
}

#' The VLMR and adjusted LMR tests between neighbouring candidates of a grid
#'
#' Each converged candidate is compared with the converged candidate of one
#' more profile at the same number of group classes and structure, and with
#' the one of one more group class at the same number of profiles and
#' structure. A comparison that cannot be computed (a candidate on a boundary,
#' a singular information) keeps its row, with `NA` statistics and the reason
#' in `note`; the warnings raised while scoring a candidate are recorded there
#' too.
#' @param x A `multilpa_enumeration`.
#' @return A data frame, one row per comparison: `direction`
#'   (`"profiles"` or `"group_classes"`), `null_candidate`,
#'   `alternative_candidate`, `n_profiles`, `n_group_classes`, `model` (of the
#'   alternative), then the columns of `.latents_vuong_row()` and `note`.
#' @noRd
.latents_lmr_table <- function(x) {
  table <- .latents_named_table(x)
  structures <- ifelse(is.na(table$model), "", table$model)
  usable <- table$converged %in% TRUE
  find <- function(n_profiles, n_group_classes, model) {
    which(usable & table$n_profiles == n_profiles &
            table$n_group_classes == n_group_classes & structures == model)
  }
  pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(which(usable), function(at) {
    profile_step <- find(table$n_profiles[at] + 1L, table$n_group_classes[at], structures[at])
    group_step <- find(table$n_profiles[at], table$n_group_classes[at] + 1L, structures[at])
    rbind(if (length(profile_step) == 1L) {
      data.frame(direction = "profiles", null = at, alternative = profile_step)
    }, if (length(group_step) == 1L) {
      data.frame(direction = "group_classes", null = at, alternative = group_step)
    })
  }))
  if (is.null(pairs) || nrow(pairs) == 0L) {
    stop(errorCondition(paste(
      "No two converged candidates of this grid differ by one profile or one",
      "group class, so there is no Lo-Mendell-Rubin test to compute."),
      class = c("latents_no_lmr", "latents_nothing_to_plot"), call = NULL))
  }
  # Each candidate is scored once, whatever the number of comparisons it is in.
  involved <- sort(unique(c(pairs$null, pairs$alternative)))
  scored <- lapply(stats::setNames(involved, involved), function(at) {
    notes <- character()
    parts <- tryCatch(
      withCallingHandlers(.latents_vuong_parts(get_candidate(x, table$candidate[at])),
        warning = function(condition) {
          notes <<- c(notes, conditionMessage(condition))
          invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
        }),
      latents_boundary_fit = function(condition) condition,
      latents_singular_information = function(condition) condition,
      latents_unsupported_inference = function(condition) condition,
      latents_no_converge = function(condition) condition,
      latents_too_few_groups = function(condition) condition)
    list(parts = parts, notes = notes)
  })
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(index) {
    null <- scored[[as.character(pairs$null[index])]]
    alternative <- scored[[as.character(pairs$alternative[index])]]
    failed <- Filter(function(entry) inherits(entry$parts, "condition"),
                     list(null = null, alternative = alternative))
    statistics <- if (length(failed) > 0L) {
      data.frame(n_units = NA_integer_, parameters_added = NA_integer_, lr = NA_real_,
                 vlmr_p = NA_real_, adjusted_lr = NA_real_, almr_p = NA_real_,
                 reference_mean = NA_real_, reference_sd = NA_real_)
    } else tryCatch(.latents_vuong_row(alternative$parts, null$parts),
      latents_invalid_lmr = identity,
      latents_singular_information = identity,
      latents_inaccurate_probability = identity)
    comparison_reason <- character()
    if (inherits(statistics, "condition")) {
      comparison_reason <- conditionMessage(statistics)
      statistics <- data.frame(n_units = NA_integer_, parameters_added = NA_integer_,
                               lr = NA_real_, vlmr_p = NA_real_, adjusted_lr = NA_real_,
                               almr_p = NA_real_, reference_mean = NA_real_,
                               reference_sd = NA_real_)
    }
    reasons <- c(vapply(names(failed), function(role) {
      sprintf("%s model: %s", role, conditionMessage(failed[[role]]$parts))
    }, character(1)), comparison_reason, unique(c(null$notes, alternative$notes)))
    alternative_at <- pairs$alternative[index]
    data.frame(direction = pairs$direction[index],
               null_candidate = table$candidate[pairs$null[index]],
               alternative_candidate = table$candidate[alternative_at],
               n_profiles = table$n_profiles[alternative_at],
               n_group_classes = table$n_group_classes[alternative_at],
               model = table$model[alternative_at], statistics,
               note = if (length(reasons) == 0L) NA_character_ else
                 paste(reasons, collapse = " | "),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  result
}

expressions <- parse(original)
condition_assignment <- which(vapply(expressions, function(expr) {
  is.call(expr) && identical(expr[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
    identical(expr[[2L]], as.name("conditions"))
}, logical(1)))
eval(expressions[[condition_assignment]])
archived <- readRDS("validation/review-fit-search-2026-10-22/mclust-benchmark-inputs.rds")
source("equivalence/search/spike-measure.R")
capture <- function(expr) {
  warnings <- character()
  value <- withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) {
    warnings <<- c(warnings, paste(class(w)[1L], conditionMessage(w)))
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  })
  list(value = value, warnings = warnings)
}
score <- function(data, fit) {
  x <- as.matrix(data)
  p <- fit$parameters
  density <- vapply(seq_along(p$pro), function(k) {
    centered <- sweep(x, 2L, p$mean[, k], "-")
    ch <- chol(p$variance$sigma[, , k])
    standardized <- forwardsolve(t(ch), t(centered))
    log(p$pro[k]) - ncol(x) * log(2 * pi)/2 - sum(log(diag(ch))) -
      colSums(standardized^2)/2
  }, numeric(nrow(x)))
  origin <- apply(density, 1L, max)
  sum(origin + log(rowSums(exp(density - origin))))
}
cells <- data.frame(condition = c("lpa_vvi_k3", "lpa_vvv_k2", "lpa_vvv_k2"),
                    replicate = c(1L, 1L, 12L), k = c(4L, 3L, 3L))
results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(i) {
  cell <- cells[i, ]
  spec <- conditions[[cell$condition]]
  seed <- 20261021L + 1000L * spec$index + cell$replicate
  data <- simulab::simulate_lpa(n = spec$n, means = spec$means,
                                sds = spec$sds, seed = seed)
  data <- data[grep("^indicator_", names(data))]
  fits <- lapply(c(1e-5, 1e-8, 1e-10), function(tolerance) {
    captured <- capture(Mclust(data, G = cell$k, modelNames = spec$model,
                              control = emControl(tol = tolerance), verbose = FALSE))
    fit <- captured$value
    overall <- vapply(data, function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^2), numeric(1))
    independent_ratio <- min(vapply(seq_len(cell$k), function(k) {
      standardized <- fit$parameters$variance$sigma[, , k] /
        sqrt(outer(overall, overall))
      min(eigen(standardized, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values)
    }, numeric(1)))
    shared_ratio <- spike_measure(list(covariances = fit$parameters$variance$sigma), overall)
    stopifnot(abs(independent_ratio - shared_ratio) < 1e-12)
    data.frame(cell, tolerance = tolerance, reported_ll = fit$loglik,
      rescored_ll = score(data, fit), ratio = independent_ratio,
      min_mass = min(colSums(fit$z)), warnings = paste(captured$warnings, collapse = ";"))
  })
  summary <- do.call(rbind, fits)
  reference <- subset(archived, condition == cell$condition &
                       replicate == cell$replicate & k == cell$k & !prior)
  stopifnot(nrow(reference) == 1L,
            abs(summary$reported_ll[1L] - reference$mclust_ll) < 1e-8,
            abs(summary$ratio[1L] - reference$ratio) < 1e-10)
  summary
})
results <- do.call(rbind, results)

# Algebraic counterexample to documentation claiming mass < parameter count
# forces singularity. Soft responsibilities preserve affine support even with
# arbitrarily small total mass.
x <- rbind(c(0, 0), c(1, 0), c(0, 1))
responsibility <- rep(.01, 3)
mean <- colSums(x * responsibility) / sum(responsibility)
centered <- sweep(x, 2L, mean, "-")
covariance <- crossprod(centered * sqrt(responsibility)) / sum(responsibility)
print(list(mass = sum(responsibility), gaussian_parameters = 5,
           covariance = covariance, eigenvalues = eigen(covariance)$values))
stopifnot(sum(responsibility) < 5, min(eigen(covariance)$values) > 0)

# Weight normalization alone changes mass when zero-weight units are appended.
w <- rep(1, 10)
normalize <- function(w) w * length(w) / sum(w)
print(list(original_mass = sum(normalize(w)),
           appended_zero_mass = sum(normalize(c(w, rep(0, 90)))),
           original_kish = sum(w)^2/sum(w^2),
           appended_kish = sum(c(w, rep(0, 90)))^2/sum(c(w, rep(0, 90))^2)))
stopifnot(sum(normalize(c(w, rep(0, 90)))) == 100)

                          load_package = "none", stop_on_failure = FALSE,
                          reporter = testthat::ProgressReporter$new(show_praise = FALSE))

            length(unique(df$file)), nrow(df), sum(df$nb), sum(df$failed),

library(latents)

capture_fit <- function(expr) {
  classes <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(condition) {
    classes <<- c(classes, class(condition)[1L])
    invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
  }, message = function(condition) invokeRestart("muffleMessage"))
  list(fit = fit, classes = classes)
}

testthat::test_that("patterned covariances use their actual parameter count", {
  set.seed(73)
  data <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(80 * 5), 80, 5))
  names(data) <- letters[1:5]
  data[1:13, ] <- data[1:13, ] + 10
  result <- capture_fit(lpa(data, names(data), 2, local_dependence = "a:b",
                             n_starts = 1, seed = 1))
  testthat::expect_equal(result$fit$n_parameters, 23)
  testthat::expect_equal(unname(result$fit$effective_profile_counts), c(13, 67))
  testthat::expect_false("latents_thin_profiles" %in% result$classes)
})

testthat::test_that("fixed means and variances cannot collapse during a fit", {
  set.seed(73)
  data <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(80 * 5), 80, 5))
  names(data) <- letters[1:5]
  data[1:13, ] <- data[1:13, ] + 10
  data <- rbind(data[1:3, ], data[14:80, ])
  start <- list(means = rbind(rep(10, 5), rep(0, 5)),
                variances = matrix(1, 2, 5),
                profile_probabilities = matrix(c(.05, .95), 1),
                group_probabilities = 1)
  result <- capture_fit(multilpa(data, names(data), id = NULL, n_profiles = 2,
                                  start = start, fixed = c("means", "variances"),
                                  n_starts = 1))
  testthat::expect_equal(result$fit$n_parameters, 1)
  testthat::expect_false("latents_thin_profiles" %in% result$classes)
})

testthat::test_that("empty subjects cannot erase a thin measurement profile", {
  set.seed(1)
  data <- data.frame(g = rep(1:30, each = 3), t = rep(1:3, 30),
                     a = c(rnorm(87), rnorm(3, 20)),
                     b = c(rnorm(87), rnorm(3, 20)))
  empty <- data.frame(g = rep(31:130, each = 3), t = rep(1:3, 100),
                      a = NA_real_, b = NA_real_)
  fit <- function(frame) capture_fit(lta(frame, c("a", "b"), "g", 2, time = "t",
                                         missing = "fiml", n_starts = 1,
                                         seed = 1, max_iter = 500))
  original <- fit(data)
  appended <- fit(rbind(data, empty))
  testthat::expect_equal(appended$fit$effective_profile_counts,
                         original$fit$effective_profile_counts, tolerance = 1e-8)
  testthat::expect_true("latents_thin_profiles" %in% original$classes)
  testthat::expect_true("latents_thin_profiles" %in% appended$classes)
})

testthat::test_that("occasion measurement assesses memberships per block", {
  set.seed(1)
  data <- data.frame(g = rep(1:30, each = 3), t = rep(1:3, 30),
                     a = c(rnorm(84), rnorm(6, 20)),
                     b = c(rnorm(84), rnorm(6, 20)))
  result <- capture_fit(lta(data, c("a", "b"), "g", 2, time = "t",
                             measurement = "occasion", n_starts = 1,
                             seed = 1, max_iter = 200))
  counts <- rowsum(result$fit$subject_posteriors, data$t)
  testthat::expect_equal(unname(counts[, 2L]), rep(2, 3), tolerance = 1e-8)
  testthat::expect_true("latents_thin_profiles" %in% result$classes)
})

testthat::test_that("staged bootstrap retains the first stage screening pool", {
  set.seed(6)
  data <- data.frame(g = rep(1:12, each = 4), a = rnorm(48), b = rnorm(48))
  original <- capture_fit(fit_staged(data, c("a", "b"), "g", 2, 2,
                                      n_starts = 1, n_screen = 8,
                                      search = "emEM", seed = 1, max_iter = 20))$fit
  arguments <- latents:::.multilpa_staged_refit_arguments(original)
  control <- latents:::.latents_refit_controls(original, n_starts = 1)
  # Reproduce the argument assembly in .multilpa_bootstrap_replicates().
  refit <- capture_fit(do.call(fit_staged, c(list(data = data), arguments,
    list(n_starts = 1, max_iter = 20, tol = 1e-8, n_screen = control$n_screen))))$fit
  testthat::expect_identical(original$stage_one$n_screen, 8L)
  testthat::expect_identical(refit$stage_one$n_screen, original$stage_one$n_screen)
})

# Does a warm start from a less-constrained model's posteriors (JStats'
# strategy) reach the maxima the default search misses on the 9 VLMR cases?
# The package is unchanged: the warm start is passed through `start =`.
suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE))
here <- file.path("equivalence", "features", "vlmr")
cases <- readRDS(file.path(here, "kit", "cases.rds"))
comparisons <- utils::read.csv(file.path(here, "comparisons.csv"))
comparisons$k <- comparisons$null_k + 1L
missed <- data.frame(
  case = c("eei_k2_02", "eei_k3poor_02", "eei_k3poor_04", "eei_large_02", "eei_k1_01",
           "eei_k1_02", "eei_k1_05", "eee_k2_04", "eee_k2_04"),
  k = c(3L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 3L, 4L))
missed <- merge(missed, subset(comparisons, select = c(case, k, lg_ll1, mp_h1_ll)),
                by = c("case", "k"))
missed$reference <- pmax(missed$lg_ll1, missed$mp_h1_ll, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot("9 missed candidates with a finite reference" =
            nrow(missed) == 9L && all(is.finite(missed$reference)))

fit_ll <- function(case, k, ...) {
  spec <- case$spec
  warned <- character()
  seconds <- system.time(fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    lpa(case$data, spec$vars, k, model = spec$model, tol = 1e-12, max_iter = 5000, ...),
    warning = \(w) {
      warned <<- c(warned, class(w)[[1L]])
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }))[["elapsed"]]
  data.frame(log_likelihood = fit$log_likelihood, boundary = fit$boundary,
             warnings = paste(unique(warned), collapse = "; "), seconds = round(seconds, 1))
}

runs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(missed)), \(i) {
  row <- missed[i, ]
  case <- cases[[row$case]]
  study <- if (case$spec$n >= 3000L) 30L else 60L
  settings <- rbind(
    data.frame(setting = "emEM, study starts", n_starts = study, n_screen = 5L * study, seed = 1:2),
    data.frame(setting = "emEM, Mplus default (20 4)", n_starts = 4L, n_screen = 20L, seed = 1:3))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(settings)), \(j) {
    s <- settings[j, ]
    data.frame(case = row$case, k = row$k, model = case$spec$model, reference = row$reference, s,
               fit_ll(case, row$k, search = "emEM", n_starts = s$n_starts,
                      n_screen = s$n_screen, seed = s$seed))
  }))
}))
runs$gap <- runs$log_likelihood - runs$reference
runs$reached <- runs$gap >= -1e-3
options(width = 220)
print(subset(runs, select = -c(n_screen)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nReached, by setting:\n")
print(aggregate(reached ~ setting, data = runs, FUN = \(x) sprintf("%d of %d", sum(x), length(x))))
cat("\nCases reached by at least one seed, by setting:\n")
print(aggregate(reached ~ setting, data = aggregate(reached ~ setting + case + k, data = runs, FUN = any),
                FUN = \(x) sprintf("%d of %d", sum(x), length(x))))
cat("\nTotal seconds by setting:\n"); print(aggregate(seconds ~ setting, data = runs, FUN = sum))
saveRDS(runs, "/private/tmp/claude-503/-Users-mohammedsaqr-Documents-Github-latents/9bfae39a-cc34-4432-8b4f-db4045409538/scratchpad/emem-test.rds")

output <- file.path("validation", "release-0.96.1-2026-10-20", "ci-final-d4c9f69")
expected_sha <- "d4c9f699525d9e07959463010e004b6362dcdaaf"
run <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(output, "39456155958-latest.json"),
                           simplifyVector = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(run$headSha, expected_sha), length(run$jobs) == 6L)
completed <- Filter(function(job) identical(job$status, "completed"), run$jobs)
rows <- lapply(completed, function(job) {
  path <- file.path(output, sprintf("%.0f-%s.log", job$databaseId, job$conclusion))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  status_lines <- grep("Status: ", lines, value = TRUE)
  status <- if (length(status_lines)) sub(".*Status: ", "", tail(status_lines, 1L)) else NA_character_
  count_status <- function(kind) {
    if (is.na(status)) return(NA_integer_)
    if (!grepl(kind, status, fixed = TRUE)) return(0L)
    as.integer(sub(sprintf(".*?([0-9]+) %s.*", kind), "\\1", status))
  }
  totals <- grep("\\[ FAIL [0-9]+ \\| WARN [0-9]+ \\| SKIP [0-9]+ \\| PASS [0-9]+ \\]",
                 lines, value = TRUE)
  totals <- if (length(totals)) tail(totals, 1L) else NA_character_
  count_test <- function(kind) {
    if (is.na(totals)) return(NA_integer_)
    as.integer(sub(sprintf(".*%s ([0-9]+).*", kind), "\\1", totals))
  }
  notes <- grep("checking .*NOTE", lines, value = TRUE)
  note_indices <- grep("Z \\* checking .*NOTE", lines)
  boundaries <- grep("Z \\* (checking|DONE)", lines)
  note_details <- paste(vapply(note_indices, function(index) {
    end <- c(boundaries[boundaries > index], length(lines) + 1L)[[1L]] - 1L
    paste(trimws(sub(".*Z ", "", lines[seq.int(index, end)])), collapse = " | ")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "; ")
  versions <- grep("\\* using R (version|Under development)", lines, value = TRUE)
  actual_r <- if (length(versions)) sub(".*\\* using ", "", versions[[1L]]) else NA_character_
  skip_headers <- grep("Skipped tests ", lines)
  skip_reasons <- if (length(skip_headers)) {
    start <- tail(skip_headers, 1L) + 1L
    endings <- grep("\\[ FAIL ", lines)
    sections <- grep("Z ══", lines)
    end <- min(c(endings[endings >= start], sections[sections >= start])) - 1L
    block <- trimws(sub(".*Z ", "", lines[seq.int(start, end)]))
    paste(block[nzchar(block)], collapse = "; ")
  } else ""
  data.frame(platform = job$name, head_sha = expected_sha,
    actual_r = actual_r,
    job_id = as.character(job$databaseId), conclusion = job$conclusion,
    check_status = status, errors = count_status("ERROR"),
    warnings = count_status("WARNING"), notes = count_status("NOTE"),
    unit_pass = count_test("PASS"), unit_fail = count_test("FAIL"),
    unit_warn = count_test("WARN"), unit_skip = count_test("SKIP"),
    skip_reasons = skip_reasons,
    note_topics = paste(sub(".*Z ", "", notes), collapse = "; "),
    note_details = note_details,
    log = basename(path), url = job$url)
})
result <- do.call(rbind, rows)
if (is.null(result)) stop("No completed matrix logs available yet.")
utils::write.csv(result, file.path(output, "check-summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
platforms <- result[c("platform", "actual_r", "job_id", "errors", "warnings", "notes",
                       "unit_pass", "unit_skip", "skip_reasons", "url")]
names(platforms) <- c("config", "actual_r_version", "job_id", "errors", "warnings", "notes",
                       "pass", "skipped", "skip_reasons", "url")
utils::write.csv(platforms, file.path(output, "platform-summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
equivalence_path <- file.path(output, "39456160271-complete.log")
equivalence_totals <- if (file.exists(equivalence_path)) {
  lines <- readLines(equivalence_path, warn = FALSE)
  unique(sub(".*Z ", "", grep("[[] FAIL [0-9]+", lines, value = TRUE)))
} else "Complete equivalence log not available yet."
lint_path <- file.path(output, "39456165092-complete.log")
lint_summary <- if (file.exists(lint_path) &&
  any(grepl("No lints found", readLines(lint_path, warn = FALSE), fixed = TRUE))) {
  "Successful; No lints found."
} else "Successful lint log not available yet."
summary <- c(
  "Release 0.96.1 final CI platform evidence",
  paste("Exact commit:", expected_sha),
  sprintf("Completed matrix job logs: %d/6", nrow(result)),
  if (any(result$conclusion != "success")) "Candidate has a failed platform check and requires a superseding fix."
    else if (nrow(result) == 6L) "All six platform checks passed."
    else "Platform checks are still running; this is a partial summary.",
  "All values below are read from the actual per-platform job logs.",
  "",
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(result)), function(index) {
    row <- result[index, ]
    c(sprintf("%s — %s", row$platform, row$actual_r),
      sprintf("  Job %s: %s; check %s; %d errors, %d warnings, %d NOTEs.",
        row$job_id, row$conclusion, row$check_status, row$errors, row$warnings, row$notes),
      sprintf("  Unit expectations: %d passed, %d failed, %d warnings; %d tests skipped.",
        row$unit_pass, row$unit_fail, row$unit_warn, row$unit_skip),
      paste("  Skips:", row$skip_reasons),
      if (nzchar(row$note_topics)) paste("  NOTE topics:", row$note_topics),
      if (nzchar(row$note_details)) paste("  NOTE details:", row$note_details),
      paste("  URL:", row$url), "")
  })),
  "Equivalence run 39456160271 (inner suite then retained references/claims):",
  equivalence_totals,
  paste("Lint run 39456165092:", lint_summary),
  "Prior failed/cancelled candidates are preserved in separate directories.")
writeLines(summary, file.path(output, "SUMMARY.txt"))
print(result[c("platform", "conclusion", "check_status", "errors", "warnings", "notes",
                "unit_pass", "unit_fail", "unit_warn", "unit_skip")], row.names = FALSE)

inputs <- readRDS(file.path("validation", "review-fit-search-2026-10-22", "benchmark-inputs.rds"))
old <- inputs$old
new <- inputs$new
rows <- rbind(do.call(rbind, lapply(old, `[[`, "rows")), do.call(rbind, lapply(new, `[[`, "rows")))
finals <- rbind(do.call(rbind, lapply(old, `[[`, "finals")), do.call(rbind, lapply(new, `[[`, "finals")))
key <- function(d) paste(d$condition, d$replicate, d$k)
spike <- function(r) !is.na(r) & r < .01
all <- rbind(data.frame(key=key(rows), ll=rows$log_likelihood, ratio=rows$min_relative_variance, converged=rows$converged), data.frame(key=key(finals), ll=finals$log_likelihood, ratio=finals$min_relative_variance, converged=finals$converged))
# The no-rule build no longer stores variance diagnostics per finalist. An
# unmeasured Gaussian finalist is not evidence of a non-spike solution.
all <- subset(all, !is.na(ratio) | grepl("^lca_", key))
best_rows <- tapply(rows$log_likelihood[!spike(rows$min_relative_variance)], key(rows)[!spike(rows$min_relative_variance)], max)
best_finals <- tapply(all$ll[!spike(all$ratio)], all$key[!spike(all$ratio)], max)
cat("rows", nrow(rows), "finals", nrow(finals), "unconverged rows", sum(!rows$converged), "unconverged finals", sum(!finals$converged), "\n")
cat("largest deficit from excluding finals from best reference", max(best_finals[names(best_rows)]-best_rows), "\n")
refdiff <- data.frame(key=names(best_rows), rows=as.numeric(best_rows), finals=unname(best_finals[names(best_rows)]))
refdiff$gain <- refdiff$finals-refdiff$rows
cat("reference improvements from retained finalists\n")
print(subset(refdiff,gain>1e-6*(1+abs(finals))))
chosen <- rbind(subset(do.call(rbind,lapply(old,`[[`,"rows")),fit=="kmeans_10"),do.call(rbind,lapply(new,`[[`,"rows")))
chosen$best <- unname(best_finals[key(chosen)])
chosen$status <- ifelse(spike(chosen$min_relative_variance), "spike", ifelse(chosen$best - chosen$log_likelihood <= 1e-6*(1+abs(chosen$best)), "best", "miss"))
chosen$old_best <- unname(best_rows[key(chosen)])
chosen$old_status <- ifelse(spike(chosen$min_relative_variance), "spike", ifelse(chosen$old_best - chosen$log_likelihood <= 1e-6*(1+abs(chosen$old_best)), "best", "miss"))
cat("rows changing status\n")
print(subset(chosen,status!=old_status,select=c(condition,replicate,k,fit,log_likelihood,old_best,best,status,old_status)))
cat("counts using all retained finalist references\n")
print(with(chosen, table(fit,status)))
cat("by condition and k\n")
print(with(chosen, table(condition,k,fit,status)))
cat("thin/spike profile counts\n")
print(subset(chosen,status=="spike", select=c(condition,replicate,k,fit,min_class,min_relative_variance,boundary)))
wide <- reshape(chosen[c("condition","replicate","k","fit","status","log_likelihood","seconds")],idvar=c("condition","replicate","k"),timevar="fit",direction="wide")
cat("only emem",sum(wide$status.emem_10=="best" & wide$status.kmeans_10!="best"), "only kmeans",sum(wide$status.kmeans_10=="best" & wide$status.emem_10!="best"),"\n")
cat("runtime ratios by condition\n")
print(aggregate(cbind(seconds.emem_10,seconds.kmeans_10) ~ condition,wide, median))
write.csv(chosen,"validation/review-fit-search-2026-10-22/recomputed.csv",row.names=FALSE)
cat("overall final-run timing summaries\n")
print(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(chosen, chosen$fit), function(group) {
  data.frame(fit = group$fit[1L], median_seconds = median(group$seconds),
             total_seconds = sum(group$seconds))
})))
new_finals <- do.call(rbind, lapply(new, `[[`, "finals"))
gaussian <- new_finals$condition != "lca_k3"
cat("Gaussian no-rule finalists with missing variance metrics:",
    sum(gaussian & is.na(new_finals$min_relative_variance)),
    "of", sum(gaussian), "\n")

# Knit one vignette in a fresh process; save .md, figures and the knit env.
# Usage: Rscript knit-one.R <vignette.Rmd> <outdir>
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input <- normalizePath(args[[1]])
out_dir <- args[[2]]
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
out_dir <- normalizePath(out_dir)
stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input))
work <- file.path(out_dir, stem)
dir.create(work, showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(input, work, overwrite = TRUE)
setwd(work)
env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
status <- tryCatch({
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = work)
  knitr::knit(basename(input), output = paste0(stem, ".md"), envir = env,
              quiet = TRUE)
  "ok"
}, error = \(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e)))
elapsed <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
objs <- mget(ls(env, all.names = TRUE), envir = env)
objs <- Filter(\(o) !is.function(o) && !inherits(o, "environment"), objs)
saveRDS(objs, file.path(work, "env.rds"))
writeLines(c(sprintf("status\t%s", status), sprintf("elapsed\t%.1f", elapsed),
             sprintf("latents\t%s", find.package("latents"))),
           file.path(work, "status.tsv"))

pkgload::load_all('.', quiet = TRUE)
set.seed(91)
# Unit mapping, zero weights and complete-case deletion at the tree boundary.
d <- data.frame(id = rep(1:18, rep(2:4, 6)),
                x = sequence(rep(2:4, 6)))
d$y <- ifelse(d$id <= 8, -4, 4) + .3 * d$x + rnorm(nrow(d), sd = .4)
d$w <- rep(c(0, 1, 8), length.out = 18)[d$id]
d$y[1] <- NA
models <- list(
  observation = mixture_regression(y ~ x, d, 2, id = 'id', weights = 'w', missing = 'omit',
                                    n_starts = 2, seed = 2),
  group = mixture_regression(y ~ x, d, 2, id = 'id', class_level = 'group',
                             weights = 'w', missing = 'omit', n_starts = 2, seed = 2),
  two_level = mixture_regression(y ~ x, d, 2, id = 'id', n_group_classes = 2,
                                 weights = 'w', missing = 'omit', n_starts = 2, seed = 2))
invisible(lapply(models, function(fit) {
  levels <- if (identical(fit$spec$nesting, 'two-level')) c('individuals', 'groups') else
    'individuals'
  invisible(lapply(levels, function(level) {
    draw <- .latents_tree_posteriors(fit, level)
    reference <- if (level == 'groups' || identical(fit$spec$nesting, 'group'))
      fit$spec$sampling_weights else fit$spec$row_weights
    stopifnot(nrow(draw$posteriors) == length(reference),
              identical(draw$weights, reference), all(is.finite(draw$posteriors)))
    print(list(nesting = fit$spec$nesting, level = level, units = length(reference),
               zero_weights = sum(reference == 0),
               shares = colSums(draw$posteriors * reference) / sum(reference)))
  }))
}))
# Weighted multilevel growth is explicitly unsupported. Unweighted clustered
# growth trees must count persons at one level, clusters at the other.
g <- d[!is.na(d$y), ]
g$cluster <- ceiling(g$id / 3)
growth <- suppressWarnings(mixture_regression(y ~ x, g, 2, id='id',
  class_level='group', random=~1, cluster='cluster', n_group_classes=2,
  n_starts=2, seed=2))
invisible(lapply(c('individuals', 'groups'), function(level) {
  draw <- .latents_tree_posteriors(growth, level)
  expected <- if (level == 'groups') growth$spec$n_clusters else growth$spec$n_groups
  stopifnot(nrow(draw$posteriors) == expected, identical(draw$weights, rep(1, expected)))
  print(list(growth_level=level, units=expected))
}))
# Ambiguous categories, source aliases, missing source columns and prediction subsets.
types <- list(numeric=c(2, 10), integer=1:2, logical=c(FALSE, TRUE),
              character=c('a','b'), factor=factor(c('a','b'), levels=c('b','a')),
              ordered=ordered(c('a','b'), levels=c('b','a')))
invisible(lapply(types, function(value) {
  frame <- data.frame(a=value[rep(1:2, each=2)], b=rep(0:1,2), c=rep(0:1,2))
  joined <- .latents_join_pairs(frame, .latents_parse_pairs('a:b'))
  stopifnot(nlevels(joined[['a:b']])==4L,
            identical(.latents_join_pairs(joined, .latents_parse_pairs('a:b')),joined))
  fit <- lca(frame,c('a','b','c'),1,local_dependence='a:b',n_starts=1,seed=1)
  stopifnot(all(predict(fit, frame[1,,drop=FALSE], type='posterior')==1))
}))
# Audit duplication/identity checks before the pair is removed from vars.
a <- expand.grid(a=0:1,b=0:1,c=0:1)
probe <- tryCatch(lca(a,c('a','a','b','c'),1,local_dependence='a:b',n_starts=1,seed=1),
                   error=function(e)e)
cat('Duplicate original vars result:', class(probe)[1], '\n')
cat('ADVERSARIAL REVIEW COMPLETE\n')

# On the archived heteroscedastic benchmark (lpa_vvi_k3, lpa_vvv_k2; 40 datasets,
# 80 fits), one start from mclust's model-based hierarchical clustering (VVV
# criterion, SVD, mclust's default), run by latents' own EM. Compared with the
# recorded kmeans_10 and emem_10 results and the recorded best non-spike maximum.
suppressMessages({pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE); library(mclust); library(simulab)})
source(file.path("equivalence", "search", "spike-measure.R"))
recorded <- read.csv(file.path("validation", "review-fit-search-2026-10-22", "recomputed.csv"))
recorded <- subset(recorded, condition %in% c("lpa_vvi_k3", "lpa_vvv_k2"))
specs <- list(
  lpa_vvi_k3 = list(model = "VVI", n = 300, means = rbind(c(0, 0, 0, 0), c(1.5, 1.5, 0, 0), c(0, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5)),
                    sds = rbind(rep(1, 4), rep(0.7, 4), rep(1.3, 4))),
  lpa_vvv_k2 = list(model = "VVV", n = 300, means = rbind(rep(0, 5), c(1.2, 1.2, 1.2, 0, 0)),
                    sds = rbind(rep(1, 5), rep(0.8, 5))))
start_from <- function(y, partition, full) {
  k <- max(partition); p <- ncol(y)
  overall <- stats::cov(y) * (nrow(y) - 1) / nrow(y)
  spread <- lapply(seq_len(k), function(g) {
    rows <- partition == g
    if (sum(rows) <= p + 1L) return(overall)
    stats::cov(y[rows, , drop = FALSE]) * (sum(rows) - 1) / sum(rows)
  })
  means <- t(vapply(seq_len(k), \(g) colMeans(y[partition == g, , drop = FALSE]), numeric(p)))
  start <- list(means = means, variances = t(vapply(spread, diag, numeric(p))),
                profile_probabilities = matrix(tabulate(partition, k) / nrow(y), 1L),
                group_probabilities = 1)
  if (full) start$covariances <- array(unlist(spread), c(p, p, k))
  structure(start, class = "multilpa_start")
}
keys <- unique(subset(recorded, select = c(condition, replicate, seed, k, best)))
started <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
hc_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(keys)), function(i) {
  key <- keys[i, ]
  spec <- specs[[key$condition]]
  d <- simulate_lpa(n = spec$n, means = spec$means, sds = spec$sds, seed = key$seed)
  vars <- grep("^indicator_", names(d), value = TRUE)
  y <- as.matrix(subset(d, select = vars))
  partition <- as.vector(hclass(hc(y, modelName = "VVV", use = "SVD"), key$k))
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(lpa(d, vars, key$k, model = spec$model, n_starts = 1, seed = key$seed,
                                 start = start_from(y, partition, spec$model == "VVV")),
                             warning = function(w) invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
  overall <- apply(y, 2, \(v) mean((v - mean(v))^2))
  data.frame(key, hc_ll = fit$log_likelihood, hc_ratio = spike_measure(fit, overall),
             hc_min_class = min(colSums(fit$subject_posteriors)), hc_start_smallest = min(tabulate(partition, key$k)))
})
hc_rows <- do.call(rbind, hc_rows)
cat("seconds:", round(proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - started, 1), "\n")
spike <- function(r) !is.na(r) & r < .01
wide <- reshape(subset(recorded, select = c(condition, replicate, k, fit, log_likelihood, min_relative_variance)),
                idvar = c("condition", "replicate", "k"), timevar = "fit", direction = "wide")
all_rows <- merge(hc_rows, wide, by = c("condition", "replicate", "k"))
# A non-spike hc solution above the recorded reference raises the reference.
all_rows$reference <- pmax(all_rows$best, ifelse(spike(all_rows$hc_ratio), -Inf, all_rows$hc_ll))
status <- function(ll, ratio, reference) ifelse(spike(ratio), "spike",
  ifelse(reference - ll <= 1e-6 * (1 + abs(reference)), "best", "miss"))
pool_takes_hc <- all_rows$hc_ll > all_rows$log_likelihood.kmeans_10 + 1e-6
all_rows <- within(all_rows, {
  kmeans_10 <- status(log_likelihood.kmeans_10, min_relative_variance.kmeans_10, reference)
  emem_10 <- status(log_likelihood.emem_10, min_relative_variance.emem_10, reference)
  hc_only <- status(hc_ll, hc_ratio, reference)
  kmeans_10_plus_hc <- status(pmax(log_likelihood.kmeans_10, hc_ll),
                              ifelse(pool_takes_hc, hc_ratio, min_relative_variance.kmeans_10), reference)
})
long <- reshape(subset(all_rows, select = c(condition, replicate, k, kmeans_10, emem_10, hc_only, kmeans_10_plus_hc)),
                direction = "long", varying = c("kmeans_10", "emem_10", "hc_only", "kmeans_10_plus_hc"),
                v.names = "status", timevar = "search", times = c("kmeans_10", "emem_10", "hc_only", "kmeans_10_plus_hc"),
                idvar = c("condition", "replicate", "k"))
print(with(long, table(search, status)))
print(with(long, table(paste(condition, k), search, status)))
cat("\nreference raised by a non-spike hc maximum in", sum(all_rows$reference > all_rows$best + 1e-6), "fits\n")
print(subset(all_rows, hc_only == "spike" | (kmeans_10_plus_hc != kmeans_10),
             select = c(condition, replicate, k, best, hc_ll, hc_ratio, hc_min_class, log_likelihood.kmeans_10,
                        kmeans_10, kmeans_10_plus_hc)), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(all_rows, "/private/tmp/claude-503/-Users-mohammedsaqr-Documents-Github-latents/9bfae39a-cc34-4432-8b4f-db4045409538/scratchpad/heavy/hc-benchmark.rds")
