pkgload::load_all(quiet = TRUE)

# Independent one-profile Gaussian reference for a nonadjacent, disjoint
# covariance pattern. Covariance uses MLE divisor n, not stats::cov's n - 1.
set.seed(615)
n <- 600
raw <- matrix(rnorm(n * 4), n, 4)
raw[, 4] <- .6 * raw[, 1] + .8 * raw[, 4]
raw[, 3] <- -.4 * raw[, 2] + sqrt(.84) * raw[, 3]
d <- as.data.frame(raw)
names(d) <- paste0("y", seq_len(4))
f <- lpa(d, names(d), 1, local_dependence = c("y1:y4", "y2:y3"),
         n_starts = 1, seed = 1, tol = 1e-12)
expected <- cov(raw) * (n - 1) / n
expected[!f$covariance_pattern] <- 0
stopifnot(max(abs(f$means[1, ] - colMeans(raw))) < 1e-10,
          max(abs(f$covariances[, , 1] - expected)) < 1e-10,
          f$n_parameters == 10)
print(c(pattern_max_covariance_error = max(abs(f$covariances[, , 1] - expected))))
print(subset(parameter_inference(f), parameter == "covariance"))

# Missing Gaussian responses should reduce to a complete-case regression for
# the affected indicator at one profile, with no contribution by missing y1.
set.seed(616)
d <- data.frame(z = rnorm(n), w = rnorm(n))
d$y1 <- 1 + .4 * d$z + .7 * d$w + rnorm(n)
d$y2 <- rnorm(n)
d$y1[sample.int(n, 120)] <- NA_real_
f <- lpa(d, c("y1", "y2"), 1, direct_effects = "y1 ~ z + w",
         missing = "fiml", n_starts = 1, seed = 1, tol = 1e-12)
reference <- lm(y1 ~ z + w, data = d)
coefficients <- c(f$means[1, "y1"], unname(f$direct_effects))
print(c(missing_effect_max_error = max(abs(coefficients - coef(reference)))))
stopifnot(max(abs(coefficients - coef(reference))) < 1e-5,
          abs(f$variances[1, "y1"] - sum(resid(reference)^2) / nobs(reference)) < 1e-5)
print(subset(parameter_inference(f), parameter == "direct_effect"))

# Sampling weights affect the direct-effect least-squares update too.
set.seed(617)
d$weight <- runif(n, .2, 2)
f <- lpa(d, c("y1", "y2"), 1, direct_effects = "y1 ~ z + w", weights = "weight",
         missing = "fiml", n_starts = 1, seed = 1, tol = 1e-12)
reference <- lm(y1 ~ z + w, data = d, weights = weight)
coefficients <- c(f$means[1, "y1"], unname(f$direct_effects))
print(c(weighted_missing_effect_max_error = max(abs(coefficients - coef(reference)))))
stopifnot(max(abs(coefficients - coef(reference))) < 1e-5)
cat("Independent covariance, missing-response and weighted regression references passed.\n")

})

# With a well-posed objective (the existing Fraley-Raftery prior as a stand-in),
# do kmeans and emEM still disagree, and what do they recover?
suppressMessages({pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE); library(mclust); library(simulab)})
source(file.path("equivalence", "search", "spike-measure.R"))
cl <- \(fit) max.col(fit$subject_posteriors)
quiet <- \(expr) withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w) invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
spec <- list(n = 300, means = rbind(rep(0, 5), c(1.2, 1.2, 1.2, 0, 0)), sds = rbind(rep(1, 5), rep(0.8, 5)))
rows <- lapply(c(2, 6, 9, 10, 12, 16, 19), function(replicate) {
  seed <- 20261021L + 1000L * 2L + replicate
  d <- simulate_lpa(n = spec$n, means = spec$means, sds = spec$sds, seed = seed)
  vars <- grep("^indicator_", names(d), value = TRUE)
  overall <- vapply(d[vars], \(v) mean((v - mean(v))^2), numeric(1))
  one <- function(search, prior) {
    fit <- quiet(lpa(d, vars, 2, model = "VVV", seed = seed, search = search, prior = prior))
    c(ARI = adjustedRandIndex(cl(fit), d$profile), min_class = min(colSums(fit$subject_posteriors)),
      ratio = spike_measure(fit, overall))
  }
  out <- rbind(kmeans = one("kmeans", NULL), emEM = one("emEM", NULL),
               kmeans_prior = one("kmeans", prior_control()), emEM_prior = one("emEM", prior_control()))
  data.frame(replicate, fit = rownames(out), out, row.names = NULL)
})
all_rows <- do.call(rbind, rows)
print(all_rows, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
print(aggregate(cbind(ARI, min_class) ~ fit, all_rows, median))

results <- list()

                                 classification = unique(get_results(small, "classification")$model),
                                 attributes_models = names(attr(small, "models")))
results$comparison_all_mixture_regression <- capture({
 f1 <- quiet(mixture_regression(y ~ z, d, n_classes = 1, seed = 1))
 f2 <- quiet(mixture_regression(y ~ z, d, n_classes = 2, seed = 1))
 get_results(compare_models(a = f1, b = f2), "all")
})

results$family_null <- capture(get_results(fam, NULL))
# Identical centered values with different raw observations.

                    centering = "grand", n_starts = 1, seed = 1))

                    centering = "grand", n_starts = 1, seed = 1))

dcat2 <- transform(dcat, a = ifelse(a == "low", "yes", "no"), b = ifelse(b == "low", "yes", "no"))

c2 <- quiet(lca(dcat2, c("a", "b"), n_classes = 2, n_starts = 1, seed = 1))

Sys.setenv(VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1)
pkgload::load_all(quiet=TRUE)
capture_fit <- function(...) {
  warnings <- list()
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(multilpa(...), warning=function(notice) {
    warnings[[length(warnings)+1L]] <<- list(class=class(notice)[1L], message=conditionMessage(notice))
    invokeRestart('muffleWarning')
  }), error=function(e) list(error=conditionMessage(e)))
  list(fit=fit,warnings=warnings)
}
set.seed(7)
weighted <- data.frame(g=rep(1:40,each=2), a=rnorm(80), b=rnorm(80))
weighted[1:6,c('a','b')] <- weighted[1:6,c('a','b')] + 20

set.seed(19)
between <- data.frame(g=rep(1:40,each=3), a=rnorm(120), b=rnorm(120))

probe.terminal_expression: data.frame(separation = separation, condition = kappa(information, exact = TRUE), max_null_weight = max(abs(lambda[abs(lambda - 1) > 0.1])), propagated_bound = norm(propagated, "2"), nonzero_weights = sum(lambda != 0))
probe.source:
probe <- function(separation) {
  set.seed(83)
  scores <- matrix(rnorm(400 * 5), 400, 5)
  null_scores <- cbind(scores[, 1], scores[, 1] + separation * scores[, 2], scores[, 3:4])
  null_information <- crossprod(null_scores)
  a <- list(scores = scores, information = crossprod(scores))
  b <- list(scores = null_scores, information = null_information)
  lambda <- .latents_vuong_weights(a, b)
  scale <- 1 / sqrt(diag(null_information))
  information <- null_information * tcrossprod(scale)
  root <- chol(information)
  inverse <- backsolve(root, diag(ncol(information)))
  gamma <- (ncol(root) + 1) * .Machine$double.eps /
    (1 - (ncol(root) + 1) * .Machine$double.eps)
  error <- gamma * crossprod(abs(root))
  propagated <- crossprod(abs(inverse), error %*% abs(inverse))
  data.frame(separation = separation, condition = kappa(information, exact = TRUE),
    max_null_weight = max(abs(lambda[abs(lambda - 1) > 0.1])),
    propagated_bound = norm(propagated, "2"), nonzero_weights = sum(lambda != 0))
}
